## Summary

A housing interview excerpt examines wages, mortgage rates, land costs, zoning, impact fees and possible federal policy responses. It ends with the institutional pressures on a bearish sell-side analyst before the financial crisis.

The full interview review evaluates the guest affordability figures, FHA claims and policy proposals with their qualifications. Eisman asks for concrete mechanisms and explains loan-to-value; this edited publication does not create an additional independent housing forecast.
